concepts: Design a polished native PC horror-game RESULTS SCREEN concept for the original game HOLLOW CURRENT / THE BELLWETHER HOUSE. 16:9 landscape, high-end restrained art direction. Use the attached screenshot only as an architectural reference for the house; remove all screenshot HUD, hands and tools. Direction: archival field dossier, near-black charcoal desktop with tactile aged-paper accents and restrained copper/brass lines. Left half: clear typography and breathing room, small uppercase 'CASE 014 / INVESTIGATION COMPLETE', beautiful large ivory editorial serif title 'The house falls silent.', short two-line debrief. Right half: a large atmospheric photograph of this two-storey gabled house at night, cream porch and four windows, mounted like a field photograph with subtle handwritten case annotation. Bottom: three compact elegantly separated metrics labelled EVIDENCE, HUNTS SURVIVED, FIELD TIME with values 3 / 3, 1, 10:42. No giant flat coloured rectangle; no cluttered corkboard, no fake computer windows, no ornate gothic decorations. This is a UI design study; all text and buttons will later be rebuilt as live native controls.
